purpose: Finite future analyst setups, not executed reference fixtures or device defaults
common-setup: Editable test-owned Set; enabled isolated instrument on MIDI track; Monitor In; no later effects; track/master unmuted; output gain audible and attenuated; retain every displayed mode/value.

Analyst baseline: 4/4, 120 BPM, 48 kHz, host block 256; separated MIDI 60 velocity 96, beat 1 on/beat 3 off; overlap 48 on beat 1, 60 on beat 2, offs beats 3/4. All are stimulus choices, never product limits.

No sample file is fabricated by this author tool. Before media cases retain test-owned 2 s WAV sample A with distinct transient plus sustain and 1 s AIFF B, record bytes/rate/channels/hash. If unavailable case remains U.
Independent expression test uses two notes and separately identified per-note pitch/pressure/slide versus global pitch bend; exact transport codec remains with MPE owner.
positive-signal-guard: Enable oscillator/engine/sample and destination section, route source to audible output, set nonzero base gain, nonzero modulation/effect amount and nonzero stimulus; clear other routes and avoid mute/dry-only/zero-send baselines.

No-effect comparison first needs paired active positive baseline. Change only deliberate zero amount, disabled route, eligibility switch or ineligible target under test; never grade silence from an absent sample/note or inactive path.
Controls/state comparators inspect visible named state only. Acoustic adjectives, static package fields, defaults, CPU prose and names never substitute for retained output evidence.

device_states.DF: Mono Legato on, Thickness interior, nonzero Glide, Cycling Env2 -> Osc1 Shape and LFO -> cutoff with nonzero depths; oscillator/filter routing active; Note PB on.
device_states.DS: Owned sample A Start 25% Length 50%, Gate envelope, active Loop playback effect and filter, Slide -> FX1 nonzero; separately Trigger Hold inf.
device_states.ME: A/B engines and filters on, nonzero cross-engine modulation, linked envelopes, stacked voices enabled with Spread -> Pan nonzero, Glide nonzero, Use Current Scale on.
device_states.OP: A carrier/B modulator active in retained algorithm, nonzero B level/envelope, LFO/pitch envelope routes active, Loop envelope, Voices 2, nonzero Spread/Glide.
device_states.WT: Owned imported wavetable A with Raw off, both main oscillators active, Split filters, Env2/LFO1 routes nonzero, Loop envelope, Poly Voices set, Unison Classic nonzero.
